summary.text: James Sceniak is the Libertarian nominee for Indiana's 7th Congressional District and Vice Chair of the Libertarian Party of Indiana. He was the Libertarian nominee for U.S. Senate in 2022 and for Indiana's 6th District in 2024, and according to BallotReady he works as a behavior therapist.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in human services from Bethel College (2012) and an associate degree in human resources from Ivy Tech Community College, according to his BallotReady profile.

Has worked as a registered behavior technician at the Applied Behavior Center for Autism (2018-2020) and Autism Companion Services (2020-2023), and as lead registered behavior therapist at Centria Health Care (2023 to present), per the same profile.
Appeared on the November 2023 ballot for Greenwood City Council at-large, according to BallotReady.
Was the Libertarian nominee for U.S. Senate in 2022, receiving 3.4% of the vote (63,823 votes) behind Republican Todd Young and Democrat Thomas McDermott Jr.
Was the Libertarian nominee for Indiana's 6th District in 2024, receiving 4.4% (13,711 votes) in the race won by Jefferson Shreve.
Serves as Vice Chair of the Libertarian Party of Indiana and was nominated for the 7th District at the Libertarian convention on March 22, 2026.
